question: How many mass shootings will the U.S. experience in October 2026?

calls.reasoning: MST's 2026 JSON lists 13 October incidents through Oct 10 (~32% of month elapsed), consistent with ~1.3/day (GVA, stricter definition, logged ~11 Oct incidents by Oct 10 and 33 in Sep; MST typically runs ~1.2x GVA). Projecting ~1.25/day for the remaining 21 days plus a Halloween-weekend bump (Oct 31 is a Saturday) gives ~40-42 total. Upside: late reporting backfill, fall weekends, 2026 running above 2025 YTD (GVA 358 vs 328 on Oct 5). Downside: seasonal decline into late fall, MST volunteer update lag before resolution. Escape below 29.5 requires <=16 more incidents in 21 days or a stalled database update (~3%). Market check: no Polymarket/Manifold (harness) or Kalshi market found.

MST counts 4+ shot, including the shooter, so it is broader than GVA (which excludes the shooter); MST historically runs about 1.1-1.3x GVA.
- Event window: Oct 1 -> Oct 31, 2026 per the criteria; as of 2026-10-11 21:00 UTC about 35% has elapsed (MST data seen only through Oct 10, about 32%).
- MST JSON fetched 2026-10-11 lists 13 October incidents: Oct 3 (Baltimore MD, Commerce TX, Trenton NJ), Oct 4 (Sacramento CA, Albany NY, Dallas TX, Vienna GA homecoming party with 2 killed and 35 injured), Oct 5 (Portsmouth VA), Oct 7 (Meridianville AL), Oct 9 (Douglas GA, Baltimore MD, Erie PA with 8-9 dead), Oct 10 (Detroit MI). None on Oct 1-2. Oct 10-11 weekend entries may not all be added yet.
- MST's monthly 2026 counts could not be read cleanly because the fetch was truncated: August was about 46-48; September came out as 27 on one read and 40 on another (unreliable).
- GVA 2026 monthly counts (X @GunDeaths, about Oct 5-6, 2026): Jan 25, Feb 29, Mar 40, Apr 34, May 36, Jun 42, Jul 68, Aug 47, Sep 33, Oct 4 through Oct 5. YTD 358 vs 328 at the same date in 2025. GVA YTD was reportedly 365 by about Oct 10 (about 11 October incidents).
- MST 2025 (truncated read): about 18 incidents Oct 1-12, 2025, which means October 2025 MST was likely in the 35-45 range (not directly verified).
- Seasonality: summer peak (July); September through November usually lower. Halloween (Oct 31, 2026, a Saturday) has historically produced party shootings.
- Downside mechanism: MST is volunteer-maintained and may lag in adding late-October incidents before the resolution check (Nov 2).
- Markets: none found on Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi.
- Could not find: a clean MST monthly breakdown for October in 2023-2025, or reliable full-month MST counts for 2026.

calls.reasoning: MST lists 13 October 2026 incidents through Oct 10. Saturday Oct 10 has only 1 entry, so a likely weekend lag adds about 2. The recent MST rate is about 1.25/day (Sep 2026 about 38-39). October usually runs a bit below September, but Halloween falls on a Saturday. Projecting about 24 over the remaining 21 days gives about 38-39, consistent with MST Oct 2025 of about 38-39. The main downside risk is MST not yet entering late-October incidents before the Nov 2 resolution check. No human market was found (all three runs checked Polymarket, Manifold and Kalshi).
calls.reconciliation: All runs agree on 13 entries through Oct 10 and that no market exists. The disputes were the Sep 2026 MST count (37-39 vs a noisy 27/40) and the Oct 2025 MST count (38 vs 39). Neither could be re-checked without web access, but the readings converge on about 38-39 for both. Run 2's lower median relied on a slower late-month pace. Runs 1 and 3 extrapolated about 1.3/day. I took a middle pace of about 1.15/day because of the autumn decline, plus a lag catch-up for the Oct 10-11 weekend, which is underrepresented at only 1 entry. I carry forward a p_below_lower of about 5% for MST update lag. I agree with the runs' reference class.
